_about: Machine-readable expected values for the accepted paper. Each entry names the paper location, source table, expected value and tolerance. These checks summarize saved artifacts; they do not rebuild the complete raw-data-to-model pipeline.
_tolerance_note: tol reflects the rounding used in the manuscript, not measurement uncertainty.
